You may appeal this decision within 180 days of this notice.

RETRIEVED PASSAGES:
[CL-C-2024-MRI-PREAUTH] Policy LumenCare Silver, version V2024 (in force 2024-01-01 to 2025-01-01). Section 4.2, Prior authorization for outpatient MRI: Outpatient magnetic resonance imaging requires prior authorization from the Plan. Prior authorization is not required where the MRI was ordered on the written referral of a board-certified specialist. Evidence required for an appeal under this section: Specialist referral (SPECIALIST_REFERRAL).

Where authorization was not obtained, a retroactive authorization request supported by a letter of medical necessity may be submitted. Evidence required for an appeal under this section: Retroactive authorization request (RETRO_AUTH_REQUEST), Physician letter of medical necessity (PHYSICIAN_NECESSITY_LETTER).
